channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2023-45249 — Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands remotely due to the use of default passwords.

item.title: CVE-2024-23113 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Fortinet FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiWeb contain a format string vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests.

item.title: CVE-2022-21445 — Oracle ADF Faces
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Oracle ADF Faces library, included with Oracle JDeveloper Distribution, contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability leading to unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-0344 — SAP Commerce Cloud
item.description: Threat Signal 61. SAP Commerce Cloud (formerly known as Hybris) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within the mediaconversion and virtualjdbc extension that allows for code injection.

item.title: CVE-2024-8956 — PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI Cameras
item.description: Threat Signal 70. PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI cameras contain an insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability that allows a remote, attacker to bypass authentication for the /cgi-bin/param.cgi CGI script. If combined with CVE-2024-8957, this can lead to remote code execution as root.

item.title: CVE-2024-7262 — Kingsoft WPS Office
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Kingsoft WPS Office contains a path traversal vulnerability in promecefpluginhost.exe on Windows that allows an attacker to load an arbitrary Windows library.

item.title: CVE-2024-9537 — ScienceLogic SL1
item.description: Threat Signal 60. ScienceLogic SL1 (formerly EM7) is affected by an unspecified vulnerability involving an unspecified third-party component.

item.title: CVE-2024-49039 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft Windows Task Scheduler contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that can allow an attacker-provided, local application to escalate privileges outside of its AppContainer, and access privileged RPC functions.

item.title: CVE-2024-40766 — SonicWall SonicOS
item.description: Threat Signal 74. SonicWall SonicOS contains an improper access control vulnerability that could lead to unauthorized resource access and, under certain conditions, may cause the firewall to crash.

item.title: CVE-2024-9680 — Mozilla Firefox
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Mozilla Firefox and Firefox ESR contain a use-after-free vulnerability in Animation timelines that allows for code execution in the content process.

item.title: CVE-2013-0648 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Adobe Flash Player contains an unspecified vulnerability in the ExternalInterface ActionScript functionality that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted SWF content.

item.title: CVE-2013-0643 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Adobe Flash Player contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability in the Firefox sandbox that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted SWF content.

item.title: CVE-2024-38189 — Microsoft Project
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Project contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via a malicious file.

item.title: CVE-2024-7971 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2024-43461 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains a user interface (UI) misrepresentation of critical information vulnerability that allows an attacker to spoof a web page. This vulnerability was exploited in conjunction with CVE-2024-38112.

item.title: CVE-2018-0824 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Microsoft COM for Windows contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation and remote code execution via a specially crafted file or script.

item.title: CVE-2024-7965 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Google Chromium V8 contains an inappropriate implementation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2014-0502 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Adobe Flash Player contains a double free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2022-0185 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Linux kernel contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the legacy_parse_param function in the Filesystem Context functionality. This allows an attacker to open a filesystem that does not support the Filesystem Context API and ultimately escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2020-15415 — DrayTek Multiple Vigor Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 77. DrayTek Vigor3900, Vigor2960, and Vigor300B devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability in cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/cvmcfgupload that allows for remote code execution via shell metacharacters in a filename when the text/x-python-script content type is used.

item.title: CVE-2024-28986 — SolarWinds Web Help Desk
item.description: Threat Signal 77. SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-43573 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains an unspecified spoofing vulnerability which can lead to a loss of confidentiality.

item.title: CVE-2024-43572 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Windows Management Console contains unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-38193 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2017-1000253 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Linux kernel contains a position-independent executable (PIE) stack buffer corruption vulnerability in load_elf_ binary() that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-38178 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Windows Scripting Engine contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attacker to initiate remote code execution via a specially crafted URL.

item.title: CVE-2024-8957 — PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI Cameras
item.description: Threat Signal 70. PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI cameras contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ntp_addr parameter of the /cgi-bin/param.cgi CGI script.

item.title: CVE-2024-9379 — Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the admin web console in versions prior to 5.0.2, which can allow a remote attacker authenticated as administrator to run arbitrary SQL statements.

item.title: CVE-2024-5910 — Palo Alto Networks Expedition
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to takeover an Expedition admin account and potentially access configuration secrets, credentials, and other data.

item.title: CVE-2021-31196 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-9380 — Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS.

item.title: CVE-2024-43047 — Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use-after-free vulnerability due to memory corruption in DSP Services while maintaining memory maps of HLOS memory.

item.title: CVE-2024-38107 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Microsoft Windows Power Dependency Coordinator contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to obtain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-43451 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows contains an NTLMv2 hash spoofing vulnerability that could result in disclosing a user's NTLMv2 hash to an attacker via a file open operation. The attacker could then leverage this hash to impersonate that user.

item.title: CVE-2024-37085 — VMware ESXi
item.description: Threat Signal 69. VMware ESXi contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. A malicious actor with sufficient Active Directory (AD) permissions can gain full access to an ESXi host that was previously configured to use AD for user management by re-creating the configured AD group ('ESXi Admins' by default) after it was deleted from AD.

item.title: CVE-2020-14644 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Oracle WebLogic Server, a product within the Fusion Middleware suite, contains a deserialization vulnerability. Unauthenticated attackers with network access via T3 or IIOP can exploit this vulnerability to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-47575 — Fortinet FortiManager
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Fortinet FortiManager contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the fgfmd daemon that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests.

item.title: CVE-2024-1212 — Progress Kemp LoadMaster
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Progress Kemp LoadMaster contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access the system through the LoadMaster management interface, enabling arbitrary system command execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-20123 — DrayTek VigorConnect
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the DownloadFileServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-43093 — Android Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 55. Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2024-8190 — Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS.

item.title: CVE-2024-36971 — Android Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 57. Android contains an unspecified vulnerability in the kernel that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability resides in Linux Kernel and could impact other products, including but not limited to Android OS.

item.title: CVE-2024-38014 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 57. Microsoft Windows Installer contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-28987 — SolarWinds Web Help Desk
item.description: Threat Signal 77. SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a hardcoded credential vulnerability that could allow a remote, unauthenticated user to access internal functionality and modify data.

item.title: CVE-2016-3714 — ImageMagick ImageMagick
item.description: Threat Signal 76. ImageMagick contains an improper input validation vulnerability that affects the EPHEMERAL, HTTPS, MVG, MSL, TEXT, SHOW, WIN, and PLT coders. This allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via shell metacharacters in a crafted image.

item.title: CVE-2024-37383 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 67. RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the handling of SVG animate attributes that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

item.title: CVE-2021-20124 — DrayTek VigorConnect
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the file download functionality of the WebServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-41277 — Metabase Metabase
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Metabase contains a local file inclusion vulnerability in the custom map support in the API to read GeoJSON formatted data.

item.title: CVE-2024-38226 — Microsoft Publisher
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Microsoft Publisher contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows attacker to bypass Office macro policies used to block untrusted or malicious files.

item.title: CVE-2024-27348 — Apache HugeGraph-Server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache HugeGraph-Server contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.
